title: Cross-version native VectorLayer construction selection and command entrypoints
question: What private constructor/command/selection functions coexist with the evaluated native vector path, and how do they change 2025 to 2026?

hypotheses.prediction: VectorLayer constructors initialize host art caches and geometry state in both builds
hypotheses.falsified_by: Resolved call targets from matching-version static disassembly do not include these functions

hypotheses.prediction: Selected shape path enumeration uses native layer-selection iterator
hypotheses.falsified_by: Original function has no call to BEE_SelIterate on either version's binary

procedure: Run tools/trace_vector_layer_creation.py offline (no AE private calls).
Resolve exports only from the corresponding exact DLL version.
Compare bounded disassembly and report unresolved indirect calls.
Store decorated symbols, matched RVA and exact input SHA hashes; do not claim runtime call path.
conclusion: Static export/disassembly evidence confirms native art-cache & geometry constructor calls and selection iterator; no plugin-native object creation has been attempted or proven.
